Sanjay Raut criticizes Fadnavis over DJ noise policy

Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut has criticized Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis, calling him a 'fence-sitter' regarding the issue of DJ music during festivals. Raut stated that while Fadnavis has not taken a clear stance, ministers from the ruling coalition have expressed differing opinions on allowing DJs. The controversy arose from concerns over noise levels during festivals.
